climate.overview_html: Carbon Brief counts COP31 as the first summit since Copenhagen in 2009 to end without a cover decision, though texts on finance and carbon-market revenue for adaptation passed. Development banks announced side deals while the just transition mechanism slipped to 2027. Copernicus data put 20 November at 2.12°C above pre-industrial, the largest daily anomaly on record.

items.headline: COP31 ends without a cover decision for the first time since 2009
items.summary: At least 32 countries rejected the final draft of the proposed Antalya Pact. Narrower texts on Article 2.1(c) and the Climate Finance Work Programme were adopted, along with a step to channel carbon-market revenue into the UN Adaptation Fund. None set a figure for tripling adaptation finance.

items.headline: Development banks announce finance side deals as COP31 deadlocks
items.summary: Development banks and governments announced new climate finance initiatives outside the formal negotiations. Decisions on the just transition mechanism were deferred to 2027.

items.headline: Copernicus records a 2.12°C daily global temperature anomaly
items.summary: Preliminary Copernicus data show 20 November 2026 ran 2.12°C above the pre-industrial average for the date, the largest daily anomaly measured. The record comes as El Niño heads toward a forecast peak in December.

major_events.name: Thanksgiving coastal storm, eastern US
major_events.status: Peak Thu Nov 26, NJ state of emergency
major_events.impact: Moderate to major coastal flooding runs from Georgia to Long Island, with the worst expected from southern Virginia to the New Jersey coast at Thursday morning high tide. Gusts of 60-70 mph are forecast in the mid-Atlantic and New York area; airlines have issued travel waivers and the Macy's parade moved to Saturday.

major_events.name: West Coast storm and king tides
major_events.status: Bay coastal flood warning through Thu
major_events.impact: A Pacific storm is reaching Northern California to Washington on top of king tides. The NWS coastal flood warning covers San Francisco and San Pablo Bay shorelines through Thursday afternoon, and slow drainage is expected where rain coincides with high water.

major_events.name: Southern Thailand monsoon rain
major_events.impact: Thailand's disaster agency warned Prachuap Khiri Khan and all 14 southern provinces, including Phuket, Krabi, Surat Thani and Songkhla, of flash floods and landslides. A strengthening northeast monsoon drives the rain.

major_events.name: Kimberley heatwave, Western Australia
major_events.impact: Temperatures of 43-45°C are forecast around Fitzroy Crossing, with heat continuing in the Northern Territory. A trough across the interior brings a risk of severe storms from southern WA to western Queensland and NSW.

weather.overview_html: The East Coast storm forced the first weather postponement of the Macy's parade, and Philadelphia canceled its parade. NWS guidance puts the worst coastal flooding between southern Virginia and New Jersey on Thursday morning. In Asia, Thailand put 15 provinces on flood alert for 27-30 November, while Western Australia's Kimberley sits under an extreme heatwave warning.

items.headline: Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade postponed to Saturday by the storm
items.summary: Macy's moved its 100th parade to 8:30 a.m. Saturday, the first weather postponement in its history. NBC will air a rerun of the 2025 parade on Thursday.

items.headline: Philadelphia cancels its street parade over 60-70 mph gust forecast
items.summary: Organizers first grounded the balloons, then canceled the in-person parade and replaced it with a studio broadcast. The forecast called for tidal flooding at the Jersey Shore.

items.headline: Thanksgiving storm brings moderate to major coastal flooding from Georgia to Long Island
items.summary: Coastal flooding was already under way in Georgia and the Carolinas on Wednesday, with at least minor flooding expected in coastal New England. New Jersey declared a state of emergency in all 21 counties, and major airlines issued waivers for Northeast airports.

items.headline: Worst coastal flooding expected from southern Virginia to New Jersey
items.summary: NWS guidance puts the peak at the Thursday morning high tide cycle. Forecast rain totals run 1-4 inches with 50-60 mph gusts in the Northeast.

items.headline: Atmospheric river to arrive on top of Bay Area king tides
items.summary: A Pacific storm reaches Northern California as king tides peak this week, under a coastal flood warning for San Francisco and San Pablo Bay shorelines through Thursday. Forecasters do not expect an extreme atmospheric river, but drainage will be slow during high water.

items.headline: Thailand puts 15 provinces on flood alert for November 27-30
items.summary: The DDPM warned Prachuap Khiri Khan and all 14 southern provinces of heavy to very heavy rain, flash floods and landslides. High pressure from China will strengthen the northeast monsoon over the Gulf of Thailand and Andaman Sea.

items.headline: Sri Lanka forecasts more than 100 mm of rain in several provinces
items.summary: The Department of Meteorology expected heavy showers in the Western, Sabaragamuwa, Central, Uva and North-western provinces and in Galle and Matara districts.

items.headline: Severe storms possible across inland Australia as Kimberley heat peaks
items.summary: A trough from southern WA through the interior to western Queensland and NSW raises the risk of severe storms. The Kimberley is under an extreme heatwave warning with 43-45°C forecast around Fitzroy Crossing.

items.headline: The Weather Network forecasts a mild Canadian winter under strong El Niño
items.summary: The Pelmorex-owned forecaster expects exceptionally mild conditions across most of Canada this winter, framing the season as El Niño against the polar vortex.

renewables.overview_html: South Australia's southern Eyre Peninsula should reconnect to the grid by Friday on temporary towers, with permanent repairs taking up to a year. In India, L&T won a Khavda battery storage order worth Rs 1,000-2,500 crore. China's Fujian set a 12 GW solar target for 2026-2030.

items.headline: Eyre Peninsula to reconnect by Friday on temporary transmission towers
items.summary: Crews are building temporary towers after a storm downed two and damaged a third; permanent replacements could take up to a year. The 62 MW Cathedral Rocks wind farm stays offline and a rooftop solar export ban remains, as winds exceeded the towers' design limits.

items.headline: L&T wins a Rs 1,000-2,500 crore battery storage order at Khavda
items.summary: The Gujarat system will store surplus renewable output at high generation and release it at peak demand.

items.headline: Fujian targets at least 12 GW of new solar in its 2026-2030 energy plan
items.summary: Fujian's 15th Five-Year Energy Development Plan sets the provincial PV addition target for 2026-2030.

science.overview_html: A Science Advances study finds ocean iodine's air-cleaning effect will stall by 2100 even as Arctic emissions rise 143%. An OceanICU brief estimates CO₂ in 2100 would be 35-65% higher without the biological pump. NOAA reports 480 hurricane-hunter hours across 10 cyclones in 2026, and an attribution study examines May's simultaneous heatwaves in India and southern China.

items.headline: Ocean iodine will not offset future ozone pollution, study finds
items.summary: York and UEA researchers project that iodine's ozone-removing and cooling effects stall by 2100 and weaken slightly, even as Arctic Ocean iodine emissions rise 143%.
items.meta: University of York, UEA · Science Advances

items.headline: Without marine life, 2100 CO₂ would be 35-65% higher, OceanICU estimates
items.summary: A policy brief from the EU OceanICU project, presented at COP31, quantifies the biological carbon pump's role. It calls for caution and clear terms around proposed marine carbon dioxide removal.

items.headline: Study probes why India and southern China set heat records together in May 2026
items.summary: A team led by Gao Meng at Hong Kong Baptist University, with the Chinese Academy of Meteorological Sciences and NUIST, analyzed the intensity, duration and drivers of the concurrent heatwaves and assessed the human contribution.
items.meta: Hong Kong Baptist University · Advances in Atmospheric Sciences

items.headline: NOAA hurricane hunters log 480 flight hours across 10 cyclones in 2026
items.summary: AOML flew drones inside the eyewall of Hurricane Isaias and sampled Hurricane Polo, which peaked at 180 mph.

items.headline: MIT links data center power use to about 650 US premature deaths in 2023
items.summary: Hour-by-hour grid dispatch modeling shows the PM2.5 harm from data center electricity spreads far from the facilities, with high per-capita impacts in the Midwest where ammonia from farming boosts particle formation.

items.title: ECMWF director cites Chongqing's Pangu-based rain warnings as a model
items.body_html: ECMWF's director visited Chongqing, where a Huawei-assisted AI model built on Pangu supports heavy-rainfall warnings up to six hours ahead. Chongqing's bureau already runs a 1 km hourly AI forecast for the Chengdu-Chongqing region.

items.title: Mesotech wins Air Force weather station contract worth up to $26.5M
items.body_html: Rancho Cordova-based Mesotech International won a five-year contract worth up to $26.5 million to maintain Air Force weather stations. Mesotech already holds a $31.3 million fixed-base weather system award from 2023.

items.title: ECMWF pilots Forecast-in-a-Box for local AI forecasts in Malawi
items.body_html: ECMWF's Forecast-in-a-Box lets Malawi's DCCMS run a variant of MET Norway's Bris model, built on AIFS, on local hardware. The open-source package uses Earthkit and Anemoi; national services can download it from ECMWF's GitHub.
